effect.ru: Больше преднатяга: меньше заноса при сбросе газа, вход стабильнее.
effect.en: More preload: less lift-off oversteer and a more stable entry.

tradeoff.ru: Больше недостаточной без газа и резче избыточная на газу.
tradeoff.en: More off-throttle understeer and sharper on-throttle oversteer.

source.quote: More preload -> Less liftoff oversteer, more corner entry stability, more off throttle understeer, more on throttle oversteer.

effect.ru: Меньше преднатяга: меньше недостаточной без газа и мягче выход на газу.
effect.en: Less preload: less off-throttle understeer and a softer exit on the power.

tradeoff.ru: Больше заноса при сбросе газа, вход менее стабилен.
tradeoff.en: More lift-off oversteer, a less stable entry.

source.quote: Less preload -> More liftoff oversteer, less corner entry stability, less off throttle understeer, less on throttle oversteer.

effect.ru: Меньше фрикционов: меньше избыточной на газу и недостаточной без газа.
effect.en: Fewer friction faces: less on-throttle oversteer and off-throttle understeer.

tradeoff.ru: Внутреннее колесо чаще проворачивается на бордюрах.

source.quote: Less friction faces -> Less off throttle understeer, less on throttle oversteer, more inside wheelspin-up on rough surfaces and kerb strikes.

effect.ru: Больше фрикционов: внутреннее колесо меньше проворачивается на бордюрах и неровностях.
effect.en: More friction faces: less inside wheelspin over kerbs and bumps.

tradeoff.ru: Больше недостаточной без газа и избыточной на газу.
tradeoff.en: More off-throttle understeer and on-throttle oversteer.

source.quote: More friction faces -> More off throttle understeer, more on throttle oversteer, less inside wheelspin-up on rough surfaces and kerb strikes.

effect.ru: Мягче медленное сжатие спереди: меньше недостаточной на торможении.
effect.en: Softer front low-speed bump: less understeer under braking.

tradeoff.en: The front loads up more slowly under braking.

source.quote: On the front end of the car, increasing Low Speed Compression will induce understeer under braking and whenever the front suspension is compressing.

effect.ru: Жёстче медленное сжатие сзади: больше тяги на газу.
effect.en: Stiffer rear low-speed bump: more traction on the power.

tradeoff.ru: В крайнем случае ощущается как недостаточная.
tradeoff.en: In extreme cases it feels like understeer.

source.quote: On the rear, more compression will increase traction on throttle and when the rear suspension is in compression, which can be perceived as understeer in extreme cases.

effect.ru: Мягче медленный отбой спереди: меньше недостаточной при открытии газа.
effect.en: Softer front low-speed rebound: less understeer as you open the throttle.

tradeoff.en: The front rises faster under acceleration.

source.quote: On the front end, higher rebound settings will hold the front of the car down longer during acceleration but can induce understeer on throttle application or over crests.

effect.ru: Жёстче медленный отбой сзади: машина стабильнее на торможении.
effect.en: Stiffer rear low-speed rebound: a more stable car under braking.

source.quote: On the rear of the car, more rebound will stabilize the car under braking but can induce understeer if set too aggressively.

effect.ru: Жёстче отбой: кузов медленнее клюёт на торможении, машина стабильнее.
effect.en: Stiffer rebound: the body pitches more slowly under braking and the car is more stable.

tradeoff.ru: Перебор — колесо теряет контакт на неровностях.
tradeoff.en: Too much and the wheel loses contact over bumps.

source.quote: an increase in rebound stiffness can help to “slow down” the change in pitch of the car as the brakes are applied, potentially increasing braking stability.

effect.ru: TC2 ниже: система допускает больше рыскания и меньше блокирует дифференциал — машина охотнее доворачивает на газу.
effect.en: Lower TC2: the system allows more yaw and locks the diff less, so the car rotates more on the power.

tradeoff.en: More risk of a slide on exit.

source.quote: at lower settings more yaw is permitted before the system will intervene. This setting also adjusts the differential drive side locking for more on throttle rotation at lower positions.
